title: Calculate Monthly Revenue Growth
description:
Write an SQL query to calculate month-over-month revenue growth percentage rounded to 2 decimal places.

Table `MonthlyRevenue`: `month (TEXT), revenue (INT)`
output_format: Month and Growth Percentage formatted to 2 decimals.

sample_tests.input:
CREATE TABLE MonthlyRevenue (month TEXT, revenue INT);
INSERT INTO MonthlyRevenue VALUES ('2024-01', 1000), ('2024-02', 1200), ('2024-03', 1500);

hidden_tests.input:
CREATE TABLE MonthlyRevenue (month TEXT, revenue INT);
INSERT INTO MonthlyRevenue VALUES ('2024-01', 500), ('2024-02', 500);

hints: Use the window function `LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)` to get the previous month's revenue.

reference_solution: SELECT month, printf('%.2f', (CAST(revenue AS REAL) - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) * 100.0) AS growth FROM MonthlyRevenue WHERE LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) IS NOT NULL;
